summary: Both editions were independently reviewed against all eleven paragraphs of the selected working Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both preserve the law contrast, emphatic exclusion, conditional promise fulfillment, buying and luxury imagery, prohibitions, and final salvation assertion without adding doctrinal qualifications. Servant/serve follows current policy. The notes distinguish bracketed editorial material from unqualified preserved wording and accurately disclose the supplied bounded reports of alternative readings without replacing the working choices or claiming fresh manuscript authentication. Acceptance concerns this supplied source and evidence, not certification of unseen editions, handwriting, or exhaustive collation.
